title: AutoCAD | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: AutoCAD. Category: Designing. Duration: 4 months. Description: Introduction to CAD (Computer-Aided Design), the AutoCAD interface, workspace setup and navigation, units and drawing limits, and basic drawing commands (line, polyline, circle, arc, rectangle, polygon). Eligibility: Matric. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
